specs.Specific Uses For Product: It is designed for users who need additional storage for everyday digital content.

features: 💾 Convenient Portable Storage: Store and organise your important digital content with the DARELONIX Portable External Hard Drive. Suitable for documents, photos, videos, office files, study materials and everyday digital content. Available in 500GB and 1TB storage capacity options.

💻 Windows and Mac Compatibility: Designed for use with compatible Windows PCs and Mac computers. Check your device's USB connection, operating system requirements and drive format before use to ensure compatibility.

📁 Ideal for Work, Study and Home Use: A practical external storage solution for students, professionals, office users and home users. Store and organise educational materials, business documents, personal photos, videos, presentations and other digital files.
